Refresh rate(2 marks)

Shirley is shopping for a new printer for office use.
(a)

Printing images on a postcard(1 mark)
___________________________________________________________________________
(ii)
Printing 1000 coloured posters for outdoor posting(1 mark)
___________________________________________________________________________
(b)
While reading the specification sheet of different printers, she noticed that some printers have specifications which are not printing-related. Explain how each of these specifications can be used in a printer.
(i)
Supports 802.11n Wi-Fi(1 mark)
___________________________________________________________________________
(ii)
Pre-installed smart card reader(1 mark)
___________________________________________________________________________

(b)(ii) Allow user authentication before a user uses the printer

items.stem:
Janice is shopping for a new laptop.
(a)
She is considering between two laptops that have different input/output ports selection.
Laptop A:
Laptop B:
(i)
There is only one port on Laptop B, which is used for charging, connecting external displays and connecting USB devices. What is the name of this port?(1 mark)
___________________________________________________________________________
(ii)
If Janice wants to connect laptop B to an external monitor using HDMI, what other equipment would she need?                                                                                                     (1 mark)
___________________________________________________________________________
(iii)
From the aspect of input/output ports, give an advantage and a disadvantage of laptop A over laptop B.(2 marks)
___________________________________________________________________________
___________________________________________________________________________
(b)
Janice noticed that the screen resolution of both laptops are 1920 x 1080, therefore she thinks both laptops should have the same image quality.
With reference to the following monitor properties, explain why Janice is not necessarily correct.
(i)
Screen size(1 mark)
___________________________________________________________________________
(ii)
Brightness(1 mark)
___________________________________________________________________________
(c)
Janice wants to purchase a new printer as well.
Give two factors of consideration when choosing a printer.(2 marks)
_______________________________________________________________________________
_______________________________________________________________________________
(d)
Janice decided on a full colour inkjet printer.
Give an advantage and a disadvantage of inkjet compared to laser printers.(2 marks)
_______________________________________________________________________________
_______________________________________________________________________________
(e)
Janice’s new printer does not support automatic duplex printing. Suggest a way for Janice to print on both sides of the paper manually.(2 marks)
_______________________________________________________________________________
[--Answer:
(a)(i) USB Type-C
(a)(ii) A USB Type-C to HDMI cable / A Type-C dongle/adapter
(a)(iii) Advantage: No adapter needed for connecting peripherals / More convenient for connecting external devices
Disadvantage: Laptop is thicker to accommodate more ports / Space is wasted for accommodating ports
(b)(i) If one screen is larger, the pixel density would be lower, resulting in a grainier look when viewed from the same distance
(b)(ii) A screen with a higher brightness allows better readability in brighter environments / Support for HDR in movies and games for better contrast
(c) Cost / Printing speed / Full-Colour or monochrome / Connectivity / Scanner support / Duplex support
(d) Advantage: Lower printer price / Less complicated consumables / Easier maintenance / Smaller size / Higher print quality for images
Disadvantage: Slow printing speed / Printouts are susceptible to water
(e) First print odd number pages only.
Then reinsert the printed pages in the paper feed, and print even number pages on the other side.
--]
